divergence_note: This film begins inside a single clinical chart aperture, then opens a physical path from a question to its cited literature. Its macro close view, assembled evidence leaves, and unresolved outcome slot differ from the recent road and water films in subject, screen geometry, movement and final image.

fingerprint.palette: marine teal, clinical ivory, oxidized copper and soft glass
fingerprint.metaphor: A citation leaf opens in the chart while its patient-outcome slot stays unfilled

fauna_scope.reason: This Galveston clinical evidence workflow has no animal in its source, mechanism or patient consequence.

throughline.subject: The same copper-edged citation card
throughline.closing_state: Open beside the clinician while patient benefit remains unreported

cinematic_contract.button: The cited answer reaches the chart; this release provides no patient outcome.

documentary.viewer_question: Can a cited AI answer reach a clinician without leaving the chart?
documentary.payoff: A citation leaf arrives beside the still-open chart in the opening seconds.
documentary.source_limit: UTMB reports active use, without publishing a patient outcome or independent answer-accuracy result in this release.
documentary.hero_image: A copper-edged citation opens beside the chart under a clinician hand.
documentary.closing_answer: The citation reaches the chart, while evidence of patient benefit remains absent from the release.

cinema.visible_action: A clinical chart opens and a cited evidence leaf physically arrives in the same workspace.
cinema.human_consequence: A clinician can inspect the cited source without leaving the clinical record, but patient benefit is not measured here.
cinema.source_limit: The release gives institutional adoption but no patient outcome, independent answer audit or reconciled March and April access timeline.

retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.
